title: Understanding the Polymerization Mechanism of TELSAM
content: High-resolution macromolecular structures are essential for understanding disease mechanisms and advancing drug discovery. However, a major limitation in structural biology is the difficulty of protein crystallization, which hinders the widespread application of X-ray crystallography. Many proteins fail to form high-quality crystals suitable for diffraction, making the process time-consuming and resource intensive. To address these challenges, we are investigating the TELSAM (Translocation ETS Leukemia protein Sterile Alpha Motif) family of engineered fusion proteins as a novel approach to enhance crystallization efficiency.
